title: GPU-compute SIMT vector engine, single-port global memory (tunable)

lanes.doc: SIMT lanes, 1..256. Memory is single-ported, so lanes past ~8 give diminishing returns; role.gpu1 banks its memory and scales further.

data_words.doc: Power-of-two global-memory words, 256..4096. Compact resident-kernel profiles use 256; accelerator benchmark profiles retain 4096.
